input.creator_request: Lisbon weekend recap. Title: "48h in Lisbon 🇵🇹". Start with the yellow tram and end on the sunset at the viewpoint. Put a short place label on these shots: Alfama, LX Factory, Belém Tower, Time Out Market, Pink Street. Use the two photos (the pastéis de nata and the blue tiles) somewhere in the middle. Quick cuts. Make it 15 seconds.
